selection_policy.m36_first_pick_coding: Reuse existing M36 pilot: Random(5909).sample(sorted(all corpus IDs),100)[:50], then Random(5911).sample(population,5).
selection_policy.other_axes: Independently per model and axis: Random(4313).sample(sorted(unique IDs in that M40 ON source file),5).
selection_policy.draw: Historical sample=0; preserve explicit sampler_seed and seed_base, identical old/new. Validate BLAKE2b derivation.
selection_policy.outcome_independence: Selection uses IDs and fixed random seeds only. No pass, convergence, output length or latency filtering.
selection_policy.pair_definition: Same model, axis, item, sample, seed, prompt and deployed configuration; source runtime is the treatment.

hash_conventions.files: SHA-256 of original on-disk bytes before path redaction
hash_conventions.prompt: SHA-256 of raw corpus prompt UTF-8; canonical request wrapper is pinned by benchmarks.py hash

limitations: This selection is a diagnostic; five pairs per model/axis cannot establish quality equivalence within 5 percentage points.
Historical timing estimates are generation-only lower bounds; loading, grading, supervision and new long trajectories require extra allowance.

Historical source rows do not store prompts: current corpus identity and prompt hashes are validated, but historical prompt equality is not independently recoverable from these rows. Do not claim historical prompt hash provenance.
Historical M36/M40 rows supply selection and sizing only; do not pool them into the fresh old/new comparison.
Cjudge body generation is selected; no judgment requests are armed by this artifact.

timing.method: Sum over eight model/axis groups: 10 requests times mean of every historical ON source row.
timing.exclusions: No request rows excluded. Runtime startup/unload, transport overhead changes, grading, review, supervision and tail reserve are not estimated here.
